title: Add a script to the storefront
description: Injects JavaScript into every storefront page.

title: List blog articles
description: Lists blog articles, page by page.

title: Search blog articles
description: Searches blog articles by a query.

title: Update a blog article
description: Changes fields of a blog article.

title: Run a bulk mutation
description: Runs a GraphQL mutation over a file of inputs.

title: Erase customer data
description: Requests permanent erasure of a customer personal data.

title: Merge customers
description: Merges two customers; cannot be undone.

title: List discount codes
description: Lists discount codes, page by page.

title: Search discount codes
description: Searches discount codes by a query.

title: Update a discount code
description: Changes fields of a discount code.

title: Complete a draft order
description: Turns a draft into an order and can take payment.

title: List draft orders
description: Lists draft orders, page by page.

title: Search draft orders
description: Searches draft orders by a query.

title: Update a draft order
description: Changes fields of a draft order.

title: Cancel a fulfilment
description: Reverses a fulfilment that has not shipped.

title: Fulfil items
description: Marks items shipped and can email tracking to the customer.

title: Disable a gift card
description: Disables a gift card, forfeiting its balance.

title: List gift cards
description: Lists gift cards, page by page.

title: Update a gift card
description: Changes fields of a gift card.

title: Set inventory level
description: Sets stock to an absolute number.

title: Cancel an order
description: Cancels an order; can refund and restock and notify the customer.

title: Edit an order
description: Changes line items, which can change what the customer owes.

title: Mark an order as paid
description: Records payment received outside the store.

title: Send an invoice
description: Emails an invoice to the customer.

title: Delete a online store page
description: Deletes a online store page permanently.

title: List online store pages
description: Lists online store pages, page by page.

title: Search online store pages
description: Searches online store pages by a query.

title: Update a online store page
description: Changes fields of a online store page.

title: List price rules
description: Lists price rules, page by page.

title: Search price rules
description: Searches price rules by a query.

title: Update a price rule
description: Changes fields of a price rule.

title: Update many products
description: Applies a change to many products.

title: Publish a product
description: Makes a product visible in sales channels.

title: List URL redirects
description: Lists URL redirects, page by page.

title: Search URL redirects
description: Searches URL redirects by a query.

title: Update a URL redirect
description: Changes fields of a URL redirect.

title: Change the store domain
description: Changes the primary domain, which affects all traffic.

title: Change staff permissions
description: Changes what a staff member can do.

title: List staff members
description: Lists staff members, page by page.

title: Edit a theme file
description: Changes theme code or templates, which run on the storefront.

title: List webhook subscriptions
description: Lists webhook subscriptions, page by page.

title: Update a webhook subscription
description: Changes fields of a webhook subscription.
